title: Used to be better
text: Used to be better. Used these for years and my Fuller Brush man retired, so I ordered them from Amazon. Just not the same quality.

product_metadata.title: Fuller Brush Toilet Bowl Swab – Soft, Scratch-Free Toilet Bowl Mop – 18 ½” Overall Length
features: HIGH-QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: This Fuller Mini Toilet Mop is made with a 15-inch, rigid, plastic handle combined with a generous tuft of sanitary synthetic yarn to provide long-term durability for years to come.
PREMIUM TOILET MOP: Keep your hands away from dirty water. Safe and sanitary to use, the Fuller Brush is a premium way to clean your entire toilet bowl – even up under the rim.
description: Here is the safe and sanitary way to get your toilet bowls clean! Use the Fuller Brush Toilet Bowl Swab to mop your toilet bowls clean– including under the rim and remove even the toughest stains. All this while keeping your hand clean and away from dirty water and harmful chemicals. This toilet mop’s soft, sanitary, synthetic yarn does all this cleaning without leaving a scratch – safe on all toilet bowls. Quality USA made, the 15” white, rigid, plastic handle with handy hang-up-hole is made to last – as the swab stays as good as new. Pour cleaner into the sliding cup as the strands of the swab soaks it all in – giving it the most cleaning power. Pull back the cup while in the bowl to start cleaning – it works great to clean even up under the rim with the liquid cleaner on the mop head. The dual purpose plastic sliding cup also allows you to wring out the excess water without any chemical contact - helping the swab dry quickly as it resists bacteria growth. Try your Fuller Brush Toilet Bowl Swab today and have your toilets sparkle clean.
